title: Representing chosen integers with Soroban and Suanpan (算盤)
header: Representing chosen integers with Soroban and Suanpan (算盤)

text.text:
### Prerequisites

This game practices what we learned in the previous activity (<htcite0>), where the abacus taught, step by step, how to write an integer number bead by bead. Here you choose the number yourself: any whole value from **0** to **999999999** that fits in the nine columns of the abacus. We recommend completing that practice first.

source.page: Writing integers with Soroban and Suanpan (算盤)

text.text:
### Representing the integer you choose

Recognizing the importance of practice exercises as a way to reinforce knowledge (<htcite0>), we present below a game that uses the same abacus board as the previous practices. This time the abacus does **not** draw a random number: you type the whole number you want to practice.

#### How the game works

Write a whole number between **0** and **999999999** in the box, using only digits. It must fit in the nine columns of the abacus, so it cannot have more than nine digits (for example, `7`, `5027` and `999999999` are valid). The decimal point (⚫) stays at the rightmost column: the column where it sits is the units, and the columns to its left are the other integer families.

Click **Represent** to start the challenge: activate the beads until the abacus shows your number. The "Value" readout shows what is on the board at each moment. As soon as everything matches, you receive the congratulations.

If you cannot do it alone, click **Help me?**: the game clears the board and teaches your number step by step, writing each digit in its column. After the last step you can choose another number or click **Next level**.

#### The nine levels

The badge shows the nine integer levels of the previous games, from **x** to **xxxxxxxxx**. The level is now only a progress marker: at every level you may choose any whole number in the allowed range, with as many digits as you like as long as they fit in the nine abacus columns.

source.text: Costa, M., Cardoso, A. P., Lacerda, C., Lopes, A., & Gomes, C.
